title: 第7章 天门宗令牌第8章 江云
slug: 无限吞噬你们求我晋级慢一点
content_zh:
第二天一早，江尘就准备回青月镇了，出来好几天了，是时候要回去了。
“好了，没有什么事的话，我们就此分别吧。”
江尘对着二女道。
二女不认账，江尘也没有办法，那么不勉强吧，反正家里也不缺丫环，当是做了一件好事算了，算这两个女人走运。
看到江尘此冷漠的态度，龙青瑶也是十分尴尬。
江尘没有强人所难，她对于江尘的象还是很好的。
“江公子，谢谢你出手相助，这是五千灵石，算是我们的谢意。”
龙青瑶拿出一袋灵石，交到江尘的手中。
江尘接过袋子，看到里面居然是五十块中品灵石。
灵石分为下品，中品，上品，极品，一枚中品灵石相当于一百枚下品灵石。
一枚上品灵石相当于一百枚中品灵石。
兑换比例一比一百。
江尘看到灵石，也是一喜，这个龙青瑶不是会来事，五千灵石不要白不要。
“灵石收到了，多谢了。”
江尘也是丝毫没有客气，直接将灵石给收起来。
这让一旁的林小小一脸的鄙夷，这个江尘，真是一个财迷。
不给灵石的时候板着脸，现在却是笑容满面。
“这是天云宗的令牌，你帮了我们，算我欠你的一个人情，以后有什么需要帮忙的话，可以拿着这个令牌来天云宗找我，我能帮上忙的话，绝不含糊。”
龙青瑶认真地道，拿出一个令牌。
江尘接过令牌收起来，也没有客气，这个龙青瑶不错，还记得欠自己的一个人情，比这个林小小要好多了。

“以后的事情，以后再说吧，再见。”
江尘身影快速跳动，没有丝毫的留恋。
很快就不见了踪影。
龙青瑶愣愣地看着江尘离开的身影。
“这个江尘，真是混蛋，不知道你刚才给他的令牌有多珍贵吗？拿着令牌，可以直接加入天云宗成为内门弟子了。
师姐，你怎么将这么贵重的东西给了他？”
一旁的林小小不满地道。
这令牌不知道多少人想得到呢，但是江尘看也不看就收起来了，也不给龙青瑶说清楚这令牌的用途。
这是龙青瑶给江尘的后门，只是江尘不知晓罢了。
“他救了我们二人，给一个令牌不过分了，好了，我们也走吧。”
龙青瑶微微笑道。
“师姐，你该不会是喜欢上这个江尘了吧？”
林小小眼珠一转，试探地道。
龙青瑶脸色一红，“小小，你在胡说什么？我看你是皮痒了，是不是？”
说完，龙青瑶就要伸手去拍林小小。
林小小笑嘻嘻地躲开了。
“小小，我们二人都不是大周王朝的人，你觉得，他跟我有可能吗？”
content_en:
Early the next morning, Jiang Chen was ready to return to Qingyue Town. He had been out for several days and it was time to go back.
"Okay, if nothing happens, let's say goodbye."
Jiang Chen said to the two women.
Since the two girls refused to admit their fault, Jiang Chen had no choice but to force it out. Anyway, there was no shortage of maids in the family, so he should regard it as a good deed and consider these two women lucky.
Seeing Jiang Chen's indifferent attitude, Long Qingyao was also very embarrassed.
Jiang Chen didn't force anyone to do anything, and she still had a good impression of Jiang Chen.
"Mr. Jiang, thank you for your help. These are five thousand spiritual stones as our thanks."
Long Qingyao took out a bag of spirit stones and handed it into Jiang Chen's hands.
Jiang Chen took the bag and saw that there were fifty middle-grade spiritual stones inside.
Spiritual stones are divided into low-grade, medium-grade, high-grade and extremely high-grade. One middle-grade spiritual stone is equivalent to one hundred low-grade spiritual stones.
One high-grade spiritual stone is equivalent to one hundred medium-grade spiritual stones.
The exchange ratio is one to one hundred.
Jiang Chen was overjoyed when he saw the spirit stones. This Long Qingyao was not going to cause trouble. He wanted five thousand spirit stones for free.
"I received the spirit stone, thank you very much."
Jiang Chen was not polite at all and directly put the spirit stone away.
This made Lin Xiaoxiao look contemptuous. This Jiang Chen was really a money fan.
He had a straight face when he didn't give the spirit stone, but now he's smiling.
"This is the token of Tianyun Sect. You helped us, so I owe you a favor. If you need any help in the future, you can come to Tianyun Sect with this token to find me. If I can help, I will never hesitate."
Long Qingyao said seriously and took out a token.
Jiang Chen took the token and put it away without being polite. This Long Qingyao was good, and he still remembered the favor he owed him, which was much better than this Lin Xiaoxiao.
"Let's talk about the rest later. Goodbye."
Jiang Chen's figure jumped quickly without any nostalgia.
It soon disappeared.
Long Qingyao stared blankly at Jiang Chen's leaving figure.
"This Jiang Chen is such a bastard. Don't you know how precious the token you just gave him is? With the token, you can directly join Tianyun Sect and become an inner disciple.
Senior sister, why did you give him such a valuable thing? "
Lin Xiaoxiao on the side said dissatisfied.
I don't know how many people wanted to get this token, but Jiang Chen put it away without even looking at it, and didn't explain the purpose of the token to Long Qingyao.
This was Long Qingyao's backdoor to Jiang Chen, but Jiang Chen didn't know it.
"He saved both of us. It's not too much to give him a token. Okay, let's go."
Long Qingyao smiled slightly.
"Senior sister, you must have fallen in love with this Jiang Chen, right?"
Lin Xiaoxiao rolled his eyes and said tentatively.
Long Qingyao's face turned red, "Xiaoxiao, what are you talking about? I think your skin is itchy, right?"
After saying that, Long Qingyao reached out to pat Lin Xiaoxiao.
Lin Xiaoxiao dodged away with a smile.
"Xiao Xiao, neither of us are from the Zhou Dynasty. Do you think it's possible for him to follow me?"
